summary: Frontend-only testing focused on verifying the bug fix: replacement of victory-native (which required missing @shopify/react-native-skia) with react-native-gifted-charts. RESULT: Bug fix VERIFIED. The web preview now loads all 5 screens (Dashboard, Transacciones, Inversiones, Presupuestos, Reportes) without the previous 'Unable to resolve @shopify/react-native-skia' error. PieChart (Dashboard), LineChart and BarChart (Reportes) render correctly. Android bundle compiles successfully (2179 modules bundled). Tab navigation works. The 'Nueva Transacción' modal opens correctly from the transactions screen. No red-screen errors, no critical console errors (only benign 'props.pointerEvents deprecated' web warning from RN internals). Note: no testID attributes anywhere in /app/frontend/app - not blocking but worth adding for future testability.

issues: Y-axis labels use awkward values like 44010/33007/22005/11002 instead of round numbers (e.g., 44000/33000/22000/11000/0). Consider passing a stepValue/maxValue prop to gifted-charts LineChart to normalize the axis.

The 'Total $6.000,00' text is duplicated in the pie chart legend area (once in centerLabelComponent, once appearing as pie slice text) which is redundant when there is a single category. Minor cosmetic issue.

action_items: (Optional) Add testID props to interactive elements (TouchableOpacity buttons, TextInput, category chips, add-FAB, delete buttons) so future automated tests can use data-testid selectors instead of coordinate/text clicks.
(Optional) Improve Reportes Y-axis tick formatting to round numbers by setting stepValue/maxValue on gifted-charts LineChart/BarChart.
No code fix needed for the reported bug — the migration from victory-native to react-native-gifted-charts is complete and functional.
critical_code_review_comments: No testID attributes exist in /app/frontend/app screens; this makes automated end-to-end testing brittle (must rely on text/position selectors).
app/_layout.tsx does LogBox.ignoreAllLogs(true) which suppresses ALL warnings globally. Consider scoping this to production only.

In app/index.tsx, chartData uses index.tsx line 60 slice(0,5) but the pie chart 'text' shows percentage even when there is only one slice at 100% — acceptable but slightly redundant with the center label.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created. Existing data (Bitcoin investment, Salario ingreso, Comida gasto) was used for validation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The victory-native → react-native-gifted-charts migration is complete and verified working via web preview. All 5 tab screens render, charts (PieChart/LineChart/BarChart) display correctly, and the Nueva Transacción modal opens. Backend was not retested per instructions. If retesting: viewport 390x844, use direct URL navigation (/, /transactions, /investments, /budgets, /reports). No testID attributes exist yet so selectors must use text or coordinates.
rca_of_issue: Original bug: 'Unable to resolve @shopify/react-native-skia from node_modules/victory-native'. victory-native v41 has a hard peer-dependency on @shopify/react-native-skia (required by CartesianChart.js and useAnimatedPath.ts) which was not installed. Fix applied by main agent: uninstalled victory-native and installed react-native-gifted-charts (v1.4.77), rewriting Dashboard PieChart and Reportes LineChart/BarChart. Verification: grep for 'victory-native' or '@shopify/react-native-skia' in /app/frontend/app and /app/frontend/src returned 0 matches; Metro bundler completes Android bundle in ~11s with 2179 modules and no resolution errors; all 5 screens render in web preview.
